Class BudgetService

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.services.BudgetService
@Service public class BudgetService extends Object
The figures behind the Budget for Quarter page (issue #177): which quarters have recruitments, and for one quarter the budget row, each recruitment's hiring target, cost, allocation and enrollment totals, and the anticipated expenses, funds and bottom line. All money is in dollars and cents, as BigDecimals with two decimal places.
